# Database
# Generated by Claude when DB is set up. Updated as schema evolves.

## Connection
```
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://red_team:password@localhost:5432/red_team
```
Set in `.env`. SQLAlchemy 2.x with `DeclarativeBase`.

## Tables (7 total)

### fraud_genomes
Primary store for all evolved genomes.
- `genome_id` (UUID PK)
- `lineage_id` (str — MO family, not UUID)
- `generation` (int)
- `parent_genome_id` (UUID FK → self)
- `mutation_history` (JSONB)
- `fitness_score`, `realism_score`, `novelty_score` (float)
- `status` (str — active|pending_review|approved_gate|approved_retrain|discarded)
- `flags` (JSONB)
- `topology_data`, `timing_data`, `amounts_data`, `channels_data`, `accounts_data`, `special_nodes_data` (all JSONB)

### prophecy_ledger
Prediction records awaiting real-world validation.
- `prediction_id` (UUID PK)
- `genome_id` (UUID FK → fraud_genomes)
- `embedding` (JSONB — 256-d float array)
- `lineage_id` (str)
- `operators` (JSONB)
- `fitness` (float)
- `flags` (JSONB)
- `predicted_at`, `matched_at` (timestamps)
- `matched` (bool)

### confirmed_frauds
Real fraud confirmed by Blue Team.
- `fraud_id` (str PK)
- `transaction_data` (JSONB)
- `embedding` (JSONB)
- `confirmed_at` (timestamp)
- `source` (str)

### prophecy_matches
Links predictions to confirmed frauds.
- `match_id` (UUID PK)
- `prediction_id` (UUID FK)
- `fraud_id` (str FK)
- `cosine_similarity` (float)
- `match_type` (str — exact|structural|no_match)
- `matched_at` (timestamp)

### lineage_scores
Aggregated hit rates per lineage.
- `lineage_id` (str PK)
- `predictions_count` (int)
- `hits_count` (int)
- `hit_rate` (float)
- `weight` (float)
- `operators` (JSONB)
- `last_updated` (timestamp)

### operator_performance
Per-operator win rate tracking.
- `operator_name` (str PK)
- `attempts` (int)
- `wins` (int)
- `win_rate` (float)
- `weight` (float)
- `last_updated` (timestamp)

### human_gate_queue
Review queue for investigators.
- `queue_id` (UUID PK)
- `genome_id` (UUID FK)
- `priority_score` (float)
- `rupees_at_risk` (float)
- `ease_label`, `scalability_label` (str)
- `flags` (JSONB)
- `requires_senior` (bool)
- `enqueued_at` (timestamp)
- `reviewed` (bool)
- `reviewer_id`, `review_decision`, `review_notes` (nullable str)

## Schema File
`red_team/db/schema.sql` — raw DDL, applied by Docker init.

## ORM Models
`red_team/db/models.py` — SQLAlchemy 2.x with `DeclarativeBase`, `Mapped`, `mapped_column`.

**Important**: Uses `UUID(as_uuid=False)` to store UUIDs as strings (avoids psycopg2 uuid conversion issues).

## Current State
In-memory singletons used in `prophecy/ledger.py`, `human_gate/queue.py`, `learning/operator_weights.py`.
PostgreSQL integration pending — DB tables defined but not yet wired to API path.
